page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. The host system is driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz, providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory totals 128.0 GB, establishing a generous memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of dedicated VRAM.

Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. The instance does not include any local storage, meaning that operating system volumes and application data persistence must rely on external cloud storage services. This stateless storage layout isolates compute and memory resources from data persistence layers.

Cost efficiency is influenced by the density of the hardware profile, pairing mid-tier dedicated compute with a substantial 48 GB frame buffer on the NVIDIA L20 accelerator. By avoiding the cost overhead of high-end distributed training architectures, the instance targets high resource utilization for workloads that need large GPU memory without requiring massive clusters. The primary trade-off is the complete reliance on network storage for disk operations.

This server is primarily suited for deep learning inference, mid-sized model fine-tuning, computer vision pipelines, graphic rendering, and video processing tasks that benefit from the 48 GB VRAM capacity and balanced host system resources.
